wires.note: Brick unplugged. Clamp one solid-ended lead in the terminal explicitly marked +5V, VCC or VBUS; male breadboard end into A1. Leave D+ and D− empty.
Use the terminal explicitly marked GND. D− is a data terminal, not ground. Male breadboard end into A3.
Female jumper socket over a male header pin labelled GND. Male end into B3. This joins computer-powered ESP32 ground to external supply ground.
Find the header label 18, IO18 or D18. This means GPIO18, not the eighteenth header pin. Female on the ESP32 header; male into A5.
Female on the ESP32 pin labelled 19 / IO19 / D19; male into A7. Keep the module IN lead (W11) disconnected until the actual module input circuit is verified.

wires.from: SG90 red lead, female servo socket
wires.note: Insert one male jumper pin into the servo socket cavity attached to its red wire; other male end into B1. Do not cut the servo cable.

wires.from: SG90 brown / black lead, female servo socket
wires.note: Male jumper into the servo socket cavity attached to brown/black; other male end into C3. Keep the three inserted pins insulated and seated.

wires.from: SG90 orange / yellow lead, female servo socket
wires.note: Male jumper into the servo socket cavity attached to orange/yellow; other male into B5. A5 and B5 share one strip, completing GPIO18 → servo signal.

Read the module label; its header order may differ from the diagram. Female on VCC / +; male into C1. This is a driver module, not a bare motor. For initial servo-only testing leave W09 unplugged so an unverified floating IN cannot start the motor.
Female jumper on the module header labelled GND / −; male end into D3.

LEAVE DISCONNECTED until the actual module accepts 3.3V control with its 5V supply, without exposing GPIO19 to 5V. A low IN voltage reading alone does not prove compatibility. If verified, power off, place female on IN / S and male into B7. A7 and B7 complete the GPIO19 PWM path.

board: 400 point solderless board; use the A–E side only. First 8 rows shown. Verify actual strip continuity before power. Long edge rails unused.
